releases.title: Sticky Navigation & Course Card Layout Fix
releases.summary: The main navigation now follows scrolling, and course-card text can no longer overlap its footer controls.
highlights: Desktop top navigation is now sticky with a light glass background while scrolling.
Local TEST banner and sticky navigation no longer cover each other.
Course cards now use normal-flow flex layout instead of an absolutely positioned footer.
Long course descriptions can grow naturally without colliding with module/track counts or arrows.
Desktop and mobile layout regressions added.

releases.title: Analytics Version Tracking Hotfix
releases.summary: Fixed Analytics version detection so new events record the real platform version instead of Unknown.
highlights: Analytics and Live Update now share one build-version resolver.
The canonical build version is also stored directly on the HTML root element.
Analytics event/version displays no longer render Vunknown.
A one-time Supabase backfill script is included for V0.18.3 Unknown events.
Regression tests now fail if an Analytics event becomes Unknown while a valid build version exists.

releases.title: Private Platform Analytics V1
releases.summary: Private anonymous usage analytics with Supabase Auth + Row Level Security for the admin dashboard.
highlights: Anonymous Unique Visitors, Sessions, Returning Visitors and Page Views.
Track usage, Study/Practice/Exam activity and Official QBank activity.
Platform version adoption and update-notice/install activity.
Private date-filtered dashboard protected by Supabase Auth + admin allowlist RLS.
No learner names, question answers, application-level IP collection or secret Supabase keys.

releases.title: Live Update & What’s New System
releases.summary: The platform can now detect newer GitHub releases, notify learners safely, and explain what changed.
highlights: Automatic update check every 5 minutes with no-cache version lookup.
Safe Update Now flow that preserves local Study progress and saved results.
Updates are deferred while an exam is active — never forced mid-attempt.
What’s New appears once per installed version and remains available from Profile and Footer.
Recent update history is available inside the platform.

releases.title: Technical Feedback CSS Hotfix
releases.summary: Fixed SQL and other technical answers breaking into one token per line inside feedback cards.
highlights: SQL feedback code blocks render at normal height again.
Syntax-highlight tokens stay inline in feedback, review and Official QBank surfaces.
Exact four-line SQL regression added to Pre-Deploy QA.

releases.title: SQL Study V2
releases.summary: SQL Study became a full teaching experience and internal syllabus diagnostics moved out of the learner path.
highlights: 34 SQL Study sections with visual teaching models.
34 unique course-derived SQL Quick Checks.
Learner-friendly SQL Course Map.
Syllabus Coverage retained inside collapsed Platform Diagnostics.
